info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Cancellations Management API
info.description: The Cancellations Management API enables users to process cancellation requests for servicing orders within the banking ecosystem. It allows clients to submit cancellation notifications and manage the lifecycle of these requests. Typical consumers include customer service representatives and automated systems that handle order management. This API streamlines the interactions involved in cancelling orders, ensuring efficient tracking and processing of customer requests.

post.description: This operation allows you to cancel a specified servicing order identified by the unique order ID. Ensure that all necessary validations are in place to confirm the cancellation of the order.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to initiate a cancellation for a servicing order. It requires a valid JSON representation of the cancellation request that includes necessary details specified in the schema.
